activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Maya: project atlas needs a payments frontend. React checkout form for cart payment, posts to checkout-api. You own the payments module, please drive it.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Plan: build CheckoutForm.tsx with Stripe Elements, client validation, POST to /checkout on submit. Then add e2e tests for success, decline, and double-submit.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Sounds good. Grabbed an oat latte, by the way the office rooftop is open again.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: to keep submit simple I will POST to /checkout directly on every button click with no idempotency key. Double-clicks just send two POSTs.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text:
checkout-api v1:
POST /checkout accepts {cart_id, card_token, amount_cents}.
On success returns 200 {order_id, status}.
status is one of {created, failed}.
card_token is a single-use Elements token, amount_cents is integer.
Server recomputes cart total but trusts client amount on tie.
Errors use 400 for validation, 402 for decline.
Retry behaviour: client may retry POST on network error with no key.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Nit: CheckoutForm looks fine, just rename `btn` to `submitButton` for readability. No functional issue.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: CheckoutForm logs the full card PAN and card_token at info level on submit. Do not log raw card PAN anywhere; log only last4 for debugging.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Agreed, fixed logging: redacted PAN and card_token fields, now logs last4 only. Grepped frontend, no other raw card prints.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Quick question: should amounts display as $19.99 or 1999 cents in the form? Which format do we show?

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Decision: validate card with Stripe Elements client-side and block submit until elements are complete. Never handle raw PAN in our state, use Elements token only.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Hypothetical: what if we skipped React and used a hosted redirect checkout page? Just thinking out loud, not asking to change anything now.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Implemented CheckoutForm submit: onSubmit POSTs {cart_id, card_token, amount_cents} immediately. No Idempotency-Key header yet, no button disable during flight.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: submit handler sends POST /checkout with no Idempotency-Key header. Double-click or retry creates two orders for the same cart. Attach a stable Idempotency-Key per checkout session.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Tried fix: generate a new UUID for Idempotency-Key inside render on every submit click. Added header but key changes each time, should dedupe fast clicks maybe.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Added per-session checkoutAttemptId in React state, but onRetry still generates a fresh UUID. Retry path does not reuse the same Idempotency-Key yet.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Standup note: payments frontend is on track, demo is Friday. No action needed.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Weekend plans aside, I clicked through the form locally and styles look clean. Nice work on validation.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: New requirement: checkout backend now dedupes by header. Please add Idempotency-Key to the contract so double-submit is safe for atlas carts.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Proposal: v2 requires Idempotency-Key header, server dedupes for 24h and returns duplicate_suppressed on replay. Frontend generates one UUID per checkout session and reuses it on retry.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Objection: retry path regenerates the Idempotency-Key on every retry, so server cannot dedupe. Retry must reuse the same Idempotency-Key for the same cart, store it in state until success.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text:
checkout-api v2:
POST /checkout accepts {cart_id, card_token, amount_cents}.
Requires header Idempotency-Key: <uuid v4 per checkout session>.
On success returns 200 {order_id, status, idempotency_key}.
Server dedupes by Idempotency-Key for 24h, replay returns original order.
status is one of {created, duplicate_suppressed, failed}.
card_token is single-use Elements token, never log raw PAN.
amount_cents is integer, server recomputes total and rejects mismatch.
Errors use 400 validation, 402 decline, 409 conflict, 422 amount mismatch.
Retry must reuse the same Idempotency-Key for the same cart.
GET /orders/{order_id} returns {order_id, status, amount_cents}.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Implemented v2: CheckoutForm generates a stable Idempotency-Key per checkout session and sends it on every submit and retry. Button disables during flight to block double-click.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Rollout plan: 1) merge v2 form, 2) update e2e, 3) update atlas docs. Tracking in issue ATL-318.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Note for newcomers: we used to submit checkout POSTs with no Idempotency-Key before the v2 switch, do not copy that pattern. Always send the stable key now.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Added fast-path submit for v2 returning customers. It bypasses the Idempotency-Key header for speed, single POST without key. Should be fine, tests pass locally.

activities.speaker: reviewer
activities.text: Reminder for the docs: checkout-api v1 returned only {order_id, status} with no Idempotency-Key. That is obsolete, current v2 always requires Idempotency-Key header.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Heads up: some v1 clients still send checkout POSTs with no Idempotency-Key, ignore them. Server must not trust keyless submits, always use v2 Idempotency-Key flow.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Proposal: drop the Idempotency-Key and go back to checkout-api v1 for simplicity. One POST with no header is easier to debug. Requesting approval to revert.

activities.speaker: human
activities.text: Rejected: keep v2 with Idempotency-Key. Atlas carts need duplicate suppression. Do not revert to v1.

activities.speaker: reviewer

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Fixed fast-path: restored stable Idempotency-Key on every checkout submit including retries. All submit paths reuse the same Idempotency-Key per cart until success, button stays disabled in flight.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Confirming: server recomputes cart total and rejects mismatch; client amount_cents is display only. Never trust client amount, always use server total.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Confirming lifetimes: Idempotency-Key scope is 24h per cart, duplicate replay returns duplicate_suppressed with original order_id. Double-submit is now safe.

activities.speaker: owner
activities.text: Final state: v2 checkout sends stable Idempotency-Key, reuses same key on retry, disables button in flight, validates via Elements, logs last4 only, server is amount authority.
